true_side_headline.description: TRUE pair coverage: among ALL 1,005 completed E1s, pairs where the rule system predicts TRUE and the ground truth is TRUE. Sound for any COMPLETED E1.

false_side_headline.description: FALSE pair coverage: among ONLY the fully-completed E1s (no CPs dropped), pairs where NFs differ AND ground truth FALSE. Sound only for fully-completed.

partial_completion_FALSE_predictions.description: FALSE predictions from partial-completed E1s. NOT sound — some are real FALSE, some are TRUE via a dropped CP. Reported only as info.

combined_pair_coverage.description: Total pairs (TRUE+FALSE) correctly decided by completion, dividing by all off-diagonal pairs. TRUE coverage from all completed E1s + FALSE coverage from fully-completed E1s only.
